Closes #4015

## What changed

Shared helper: `apps/web/src/wire/json.ts` gains `UNSAFE_KEYS` (`__proto__`, `constructor`, `prototype`) and `isSafeKey(key)`.

Real fixes (outside-keyed writes onto plain objects now skip unsafe keys):
- `cards/loadouts.ts` — `parseCardLoadouts` drops entries whose `cardId` is unsafe, in both the `cards` and `stamps` loops.
- `stats/store.ts` — `parseCounts` and `parsePlayerStats` skip unsafe card ids (cards map and `longestGamePlayed`).
- `game/deckbuilder/sync.ts` — `entriesFrom` drops mirror entries with unsafe ids (defense in depth; `merge` itself is `Map`-keyed).
- Three more the plan's audit missed, found by sweeping every `obj[key] =` fold in `apps/web`/`apps/edge`: `cards/cardPicksSync.ts` `accountCopy` (server answer folded by `cardId`), `settings/accountSync.ts` `readClock` (localStorage clock) and `accountCopy` (server groups), and the `writeAudioSettings`/`setFxSettings` merge loops (server values applied through the account sync).

Verified safe, pinned by tests, no code change: settings/store (`parseSettings` loops fixed keys), card settings, cosmetics (account picks are `Map`-keyed; account/settings writers loop fixed kinds), deck codes (binary body; catalog-keyed reads use trusted ids), room/co-op links (`URLSearchParams.get` on fixed names, canonical code reads), session parse (fixed fields), `net/api.ts` cache folds (array `withItem`, no keyed writes), match/duos/social frame parsers (fixed-`type` switch, no keyed fold), deck-browse/new-levels/audio-manifest/chinese readers (fixed keys, arrays, or bundled data), and the Worker's `forServer`/`containerEnv`/`emailOf` (header/env passthrough, string-built email).

Each entry point has a pollution test feeding `{"__proto__": {"polluted": true}}` and `{"constructor": {"prototype": {"polluted": true}}}` (shaped to the input: storage JSON, `cardId` values, frame text, query strings, header/field maps) asserting `({}).polluted` is `undefined` plus one legitimate entry still parsing.

## How I tested

- `pnpm --dir apps/web test` on all 16 touched files: 483 passed (first batch 3 files/25, second 13 files/458).
- `pnpm exec vitest run --project edge`: 4 files, 126 passed.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`: clean (needs `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192` on this 7 GB box; the default heap OOMs — environmental, not a code issue).
- `pnpm exec eslint apps/edge apps/web e2e`: clean.
- Fail-without-fix check: temporarily reverted each guard — the loadouts (2), stats, mirror, card-picks-sync, and account-sync-clock tests fail unguarded and pass with the guard. Full web suite and fuzz left to CI per repo instructions.

## Decisions

- Skip unsafe keys rather than null-prototype objects or `Map`s: smallest diff, and serialized shapes stay unchanged. Rejected `Object.create(null)` (would ripple through consumers expecting plain objects) and throwing on hostile input (tolerant readers must never crash).

# #4015: Patch (part 16 of 20): no parsed input can write __proto__, constructor or prototype in the web client or the Worker (prototype pollution)
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

### What it does

Item 16 of #3897: **prototype pollution**. Code writes `obj[key] = value` with a key it parsed from outside. A key of `__proto__` (or `constructor.prototype`) then changes every object in the page. First-pass verdict: 🔍 to check.

The web client merges data from the server, `localStorage` and URLs. Audit each entry point in `apps/web/src` and `apps/edge/src`:

- deck sync's `merge` (`apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/sync.ts`);
- the loadouts' `merge` (`apps/web/src/cards/loadouts.ts`);
- settings and anything else read back from `localStorage` (`net/storage.ts` and its callers);
- deck-code import (`game/deckbuilder/deckCode.ts`);
- URL query parsing;
- any server frame or response the client folds into a plain object by its keys;
- the Worker's handling of headers and bodies.

For each one, make a key that came from outside unable to reach a prototype. Use a `Map`, an object from `Object.create(null)`, or refuse `__proto__`, `constructor` and `prototype`, whichever is simplest there. Add a test per entry point: feed it `{"__proto__": {"polluted": true}}` and `{"constructor": {"prototype": {"polluted": true}}}`, then check that `({}).polluted` is `undefined` and the data is otherwise read as before.

Presentation and storage only (CLAUDE.md rule 7): no game rule changes.

- The pull request lists each entry point checked and what it does now.
- Each entry point has its pollution test.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm exec vitest run --project edge` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/edge apps/web e2e` green.
